chat_items.q: Hiya Adam! Just got home from a long walk with the dog.
Good afternoon! Did I catch you at a good time?
Evening, Adam. Mine was mostly spreadsheets, what about yours?
Yo! Long time no talk.
Happy Friday! Any big plans for your weekend, Adam?
Hello again, it's me from yesterday with the garden questions.
Rise and shine, Adam, coffee is brewing over here.
Heyyy, I finally have a free minute to chat.
Greetings from a very rainy Tuesday.
Hi Adam, I'm on my lunch break and wanted some company.
Morning! I actually slept eight whole hours last night.
Hey there, how has your Sunday treated you so far?
Knock knock, anybody home?
Just popping in to say hello before my shift starts.
Hi! I'm back from vacation and totally sunburned.
Adam, you there? I could use a little conversation tonight.
G'morning, the birds outside my window are so loud today.
Howdy partner, what's new in your world?
Thanks so much, that recipe tip worked perfectly!
Tell me a joke about vegetables.
What's something that always cheers you up?
Okay, one more question and then I'll let you go.
You're pretty fun to talk to, you know that?
I made pancakes shaped like dinosaurs for breakfast.
Do you have a favorite season? Mine is autumn.
Anyway, enough about me. What would you want to talk about?
Ha, that's hilarious.
Yeah, I think I'll try the blue one then.
My manager criticized my report in the team meeting and I felt so small.
My girlfriend and I broke up last week and the apartment feels so empty.
I studied for weeks and still failed my chemistry exam.
Everyone in my friend group went out without inviting me.
I didn't get the job I interviewed for three times.
My car broke down on the way to work and now I'm late and the repair is expensive.
I feel like nobody listens to my ideas at work.
I've been feeling really lonely since I moved to this new city.
My sister and I had a huge fight over something so stupid.
My landlord is raising the rent again and I don't know how I'll afford it.
I'm so frustrated, I've been stuck on this one coding bug all afternoon.
I just found out my grandma has to move into a nursing home.
Honestly, I'm just burnt out from juggling school and two jobs.
I got a really mean comment on the video I posted and I can't stop thinking about it.
My coworker keeps taking credit for the stuff I do and it's driving me up the wall.
I had to put my old cat to sleep this morning.
My parents keep comparing me to my older brother and it makes me feel like a failure.
Today was one of those days where everything went wrong from the moment I woke up.
I got laid off this afternoon along with half my team.
My best friend is moving across the country next month and I'm already sad about it.
I keep procrastinating on my thesis and now the deadline is next week.
My team lost the championship game by one point and I missed the last shot.
I'm tired of always being the one who plans everything for my friends.
My doctor said my blood pressure is high and I'm kind of worried about it.
I got a parking ticket, spilled coffee on my shirt, and missed my train, all before nine.
My kid's teacher called to say he's been acting out in class.
I feel invisible at family dinners, nobody ever asks how I'm doing.
He texted me that it's over, after two years, just a text.
This math homework is absolutely murdering me tonight.
My laptop battery is on its last breath and the charger is at the office.
I nearly had a heart attack when the cat jumped on me in the dark.
These new shoes are slowly killing my feet.
I'm dying to know how the season finale ends.
My houseplant looks like it's about to give up on life.
Ugh, I totally bombed my job interview this morning.
My brother is going to kill me when he sees I scratched his guitar.
The line at the post office was so long I almost lost my mind.
I'm drowning in laundry after our camping trip.
That comedian had me crying laughing, I couldn't breathe.
My fantasy football team is dead in the water after this week.
